title: I tested my GenOS for LLM agents. It fixed prompt bloat and replaced multi-agent swarm latency.
content_snippet:
I ran an empirical test on GenOS, an environment where LLM agents are driven by a versioned YAML "genome" rather than massive prompts. By mutating traits (e.g., risk_tolerance) and breeding specialized agents together, I achieved emergent TDD, bypassed RAG context limits, and entirely avoided multi-agent "ping-pong" loops.
